data.title: Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Friday, August 7, 2026: Crypto prices moving higher following July jobs report
data.description: Bitcoin opened at $64,259.68 on Friday, August 7, 2026, 0.5% lower than Thursday's opening price. As of 9:02 a.m. ET, bitcoin moved higher to $65,143.87. Ethereum opened at $1,902.20 today, down 0.2% from Thursday's opening. Ethereum moved to $1,929.36 as of 9:02 a.m. ET.
